notes.title: Update #7: New & Free DLC Campaign!
notes.content: [h2]Thank you for playing Railgrade![/h2][p]We've been working on Railgrade now for 6 years! Oh how time has moved on. I wish it was at least half as fast :)[/p][p]Now, we made Railgrade to be played, and thanks to you all: it got played! So thank you for giving our little train game purpose.[/p][p]As thank you we've put together a little surprise![/p][p][/p][h2]A New & Free DLC Campaign![/h2][p]Update 7 brings with it a bunch of new buildings, industries, and even trains! Yet one thing players have been asking for has been new missions! I do not think you'd believe me, and I almost do not, how many players DM'd me asking for DLC. In past updates we added a bunch of optional side missions, but we felt limited in just expanding the main campaign. We needed more: we needed a new campaign![/p][p]So please get excited for a [b]new Railgrade Campaign: Rapid Repo Rescue![/b][/p][p]In Rapid Repo Rescue you take on a new planet. This one's got a problem: a court ordered repossession ! You see, years ago when the colony ship first landed: they landed on the wrong planet! This planet has a different owner! An evil corporation at that! So now you need to rush to rebuild a resourceful planet to recharge the space launcher and rescue everyone before that corporation takes possession![/p][p]Did I mention the corporation has an evil scheme to trap any workers you leave behind to a life of low wages and high company-store-inflation? You better rescue everyone! And quick![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/6c991621641bb9734d3ad877cdd79f1bd1ae95bb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Who made it[/h2][p]If you've been following the Workshop map making community you've likely played his maps already: Mortiz! He's one of our community's elite map makers. He took time out of his busy university schedule to craft this brand new campaign. Of course we paid him, cash, but I want to thank him for putting in his time & care beyond the paycheck.[/p][p]We also received a bunch of help from players on our Discord! A hardcore group of players helped Mortiz by play testing early versions of his maps. They spent a bunch of time testing and giving feedback. Plus, and I am quite thankful: no one leaked the surprise! [/p][p]They proved skilled at both Railgrade and at keeping secrets![/p][p][/p][h2]What's Inside[/h2][p]You'll find the Rapid Repo Rescue campaign on the main menu under the "Bonus Campaign" choice. There you'll find a full menu allow you to play each map as you unlock it. Including an overview of each mission's score, and a total campaign rank.[/p][p]The full campaign rank takes the sum total of your best play times, and the sum total of every map's par time, and treats the entire campaign like a combined mission time. This means you can catch up by playing faster on some maps to compensate for slower times on others.[/p][p]And like all missions: you can enable modifiers to tune the difficulty to your choice.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/b9df8251082605090e5213f26c24641ddab51802.png"][/img][/p][p]The 11 missions should take about 9 hours to complete. We gave Mortiz access to every yet-unused asset in the game. This meant new trains, new industry, and new resources.[/p][p][/p][p]My personal favourite is the new Natural Gas & Hydrogen set of energy production chains. Complete with a new Gas Powerplant as you see below, plus Offshore Gas Wells! If you scroll to the top of this page you can even spy the on-shore Gas Well Industry.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/f2f2efec4fb22be6bf45b00b636067bac904debc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Signoff[/h2][p]When we started working on Railgrade I wanted to keep supporting it far beyond release. In prior jobs I felt we had stop working on games too soon. I am thankful for Whiskerwood we've found a publisher in Hooded Horse which values long term support for games and writes their contracts to make that happen. [/p][p]That is why we made this bonus campaign and are releasing it for free. I think Railgrade is special, and I am thankful to everyone who supported us over the years when our rent depended on it. I hope this campaign can give new and old players more of the unique fun Railgrade can give :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you again for playing Railgrade![/b][/p][p]Daniel Dressler[/p][p]Lead Programmer on Railgrade[/p][p][/p][h3]PS:[/h3][p]We've released 2 hot patches these past 3 days. The first fixed an ordering issue in the DLC campaign. The second patch adds the new industry and trains to the research tree in sandbox. You can also now use the new industry chains to power research itself. :)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update #6 Patch #2 + Whiskerwood!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Based on discussions with players after our last update it became clear new players were missing the modifiers.

Ages back in Update 1 we implemented the modifiers feature. This allows players to disable train ghosting, disable the timer, and even give themselves unlimited money.

New Update 6 Patch #2, these modifiers can be toggled from the new mission menu.

Now before the full changelog I'd like to take a moment of your time and call attention to an important annoucement: we're making a second game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489330/Whiskerwood/

notes.title: Update #6: Nuclear & Warehouses Out now!
notes.content:
Hello Administrators!

Thank you for reading and playing our game! My name is Daniel and I’m excited to show off our many new additions to Railgrade we’ve launched today in Update #6. Our goal this Update was to expand Sandbox mode and give it more choices and a high tier goal to work towards.

We’ve also implemented a couple super requested features you can leverage in both campaign and sandbox, so keep reading!


[h1]Sandbox Features[/h1]
[b]Nuclear Production Chain[/b]
Need an absolute ton of energy to catalyze your economy? Consider the Nuclear Powerplant production chain. These giant powerplants are expensive but produce energy using Centrifuge refined Uranium Ore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/f9a8da502f512e08cd631725365e9d627dca8e3c.gif[/img]

[b]Minimap[/b]
Now you see the entire map at once in Sandbox. Clicking on a position will pan your camera over to the destination. Industry, Resource Desposits, and Track are highlighted on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/2d5567d38449956fcd0c3a2b9926bd04c207894d.png[/img]


[b]Microdocks & Double Docks[/b]
In Sandbox export docks are limited in how much freight they can handle in a minute. Therefore we've added two new docks to allow you better optimization when picking a dock in your export chain. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/09a39a0ce356dfa00f19232b1f9fc9964fef4b30.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/5a72fc80ccf0997d54a65a705af5de7d0a261455.gif[/img]

[h1]Campaign & Sandbox Features[/h1]
[b]Wait until full and Wait until empty Station Behaviour[/b]
Players have long requested the ability to tune the behaviour of trains at stations. Now you can!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/3eab9542c44041002507f48565e9314e53a8da0c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/a1a106e046eb0a8f428d895fa9c91c9195e30d54.png[/img]

[b]Warehouses![/b]
Next up, and perhaps our most requested feature: Warehouses! Use these to store excess freight or transfer freight between main lines and branch lines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/dfc7f30770ddce6d150509f58bdb3fc10403528f.png[/img]

Check out the full change log below to see even more features & Fixes. Thank you for playing our game!

[b]Sandbox Features[/b]
Add Minimap to sandbox mode

Add Centrifuge

Add Micro sized Zeppelin Dock

Increase the distance between lit-up arrows in the train path animation

Fix negative profits locking deposits in the bank
Fix zooming being instant at low frame rates
Fix main menu background music not looping

notes.title: Update #5 Patch #1: Sandbox Improvements
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Thank you for so many players trying out our sandbox mode! And thank you for the feedback and bug reporting! This minor patch is meant to quickly address several issues players have raised, and features requested.

[h2]Sandbox Save File Deletion[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/42a238fb3c847e5629c0fdf7ff4351eb2c3e635e.png[/img]

The headline for a number of players is you can now delete sandbox save files from within the save file list. Please be careful, as while there is a confirmation dialog once you delete a save it truly is deleted. Remember, you can always make new backup sandbox saves using pause menu's "Save to New File" action.


[h2]Bank is now Researchable & Buildable[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/08b29bc06783d918df1ff56e414bc60dfdf1378e.png[/img]

Next, by player request: the Bank is now a researchable tech. Select it from the tech tree as a tier 1 tech. Once unlocked you can purchase a single Bank for 512yen. Fear not, the Bank will instantly allow you to borrow the regular amount. That 512yen is merely the cost of the branch office, not the Bank's working capital.


Thank you for playing our game :)
Dainel
Lead Programmer on Railgrade

notes.title: Update #5: Sandbox Mode Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Lead programmer on Railgrade, Daniel here with a Christmas surprise gift for our dear players!

Drum roll please….. *drum* *drum*

[h2]SANDBOX MODE is out now![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/bf3113073682551264fdbd0958877007922e4d6c.png[/img]

Sandbox mode is our promised Update #5 and brings a brand new long form play style to Railgrade. Everyone asked for it, and we listened! We’ve been hard at work these past two months since release to make the sandbox mode we think you are were all hoping for.

Let me walk you through the Sandbox experience. I hope you’ll see this Sandbox is full featured with everything players can expect from the factory automation genre.

First off, from the main menu is now a Sandbox mode. Just below the existing Campaign mode you’ll have two new options. Generating a new sandbox, and loading existing save. 

[h3]Random Procedural Maps[/h3]
Generating a new sandbox allows you to tune a ton of parameters in our new random map generator. Each of the 5 biomes has a unique algoritmn and even unique tuning parameters. We’ve designed the gneeration parameters to be understandable. Instead of the traditional noise tuning, you can pick comprehensible choices like “Canyon Depth” on Savannah, or Valley flatness, as examples. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/52c7db505e0bdb97fa5893fcb6817953efabfed5.png[/img]


[h3]Multiple Save Slots[/h3]
Once you’ve generated a sandbox, you can freely save the map to a “Backup file”. This will generate a new save file which you can load at any time from the main menu. Or you can start multiple sandbox regions. On PC you can have an unlimited number of save files for the same sandbox region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/6800f5f72c474eeb266dce20473b63c9b9777b1b.png[/img]

[h3]Research Centers[/h3]
Once you land on a sandbox you’ll need to survey the land and decide where to build your starter city! Yes that’s right, you build entire cities in sandbox mode. At start you get 1 free city, zeppelin dock, and research tower. You’ll need these to kickstart your economy. Over time you’ll want to invest into building new cities, and even Zeppelin docks. New in Sandbox mode the zeppelin docks are rate limited. Meaning you must decide what to export to best use your dock’s capacity. Special in sandbox mode is the Research Tower. These might computing complexes consume tiered resources to break the patent encryption on increasingly valuable techs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/1b1ba340bf0efe6ed2e6c06a63fbb365193cf234.png[/img]

[h3]Tech Tree[/h3]
Techs are now encrypted and must be researched for use on your sandbox region. Use the tech tree to determine what to research but watch out for the costs. Higher tiers of research require more complex inputs. Existing players of Railgrade will recognize the tiered inputs mechanic similar yet different from the city growth gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/dcff9ae4c182dbd28cd7a68a72c68d23b7468f61.png[/img]

As you grow your economy and develop your sandbox region you will find Railgrade’s core gameplay has been expanded into a 20+ hour sandbox experience without losing the dynamic choices and gameplay first design. The whole team is proud of our extensive efforts these past months and we are excited for all the players who have given our humble train game a chance. Without your support we could not have made this happen. 

Thank you for playing our game :)
Dainel
Lead Programmer on Railgrade

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/a5845a913bf840aa28c8467e9490e31efff38bea.png[/img]

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
v5.0.54.1 Update #5
Features
    • Add procedurally generated Sandbox Mode
    • Add Research Tower for generating research
    • Add tech tree in Sandbox Mode
    • Make horizon curved
    • Add support for multiple saves per sandbox region
    • Add free buildings mechanic for use in sandbox starts

Gameplay
    • Boost PC entity limit by 5x
    • Make zeppelin export docks rate limited in sandbox mode
    • Make deliveries to research towers not pay for freight
    • Add deep lakes
    • Add option to scale frequency of idle barks

UI
    • Add procgen preview window to sandbox generate mode
    • Add save selection menu for Sandbox saves
    • Add lockout safety option to prevent accidental campaign restarts
    • Add tech tree in sandbox mode
    • Fix windows cursor at 200% DPI scaling, now scales on game start

Bugs
    • Fix cursor on Mac appearing as four dots
    • Fix water pump upgrade missing from map editor unlocks panel
    • Prevent map editor placements outside map limits
    • Fix Steam generated desktop icon being blurry
    • Fix Region 22 Branch B showing unused retrograde quest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/e0eb5446a03fe8754c5f5129a2e14555a2eb178a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #4 Map Maker + Workshop Support
notes.content:
[h2]In-Game Map Maker + Steam Workshop Added[/h2]

Hello Everyone!

We are proud to announce that Update #4 with its in-game [b]Map Maker and Steam Workshop support is out now![/b]

This is a big personal milestone for me, and a point of pride for the team. For me, I've worked on many games before Railgrade. Each time the topic releasing a map maker came up but producers shot down the idea. Now that we're in full control, we've made this map maker a high priority. And now you can us it!

But not just any map maker. [b]This map maker is in-game[/b], you can launch it from the Custom Maps menu from the main menu. This same Custom Maps menu lets you [b]download & play maps from the Steam Workshop[/b], edit your own maps, and even upload to Steam Workshop. 

As part of this work we've polished up our internal map editor. We've added a thumbnail screenshot taking function, streamlined the controls, translated everything. We've debugged and smoothed the rough edges. If you've enjoyed Railgrade please do consider making your own map. You should find the tooling easy to use and publish, much easier than the modding tools we had as kids.

Daniel

PS: If you wish to share maps with friends privately, or share your map on our discord so non-Steam players can get it, we've added an export map function too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/b8f8f5cac7153dbd97c6ffe78862be68aa5dcbe9.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #3 -> RAILGRADE is now Steamdeck Verified!
notes.content:
[h2]RAILGRADE is now verified on the Steamdeck[/h2]

Hello Everyone,

This patch was a bit unplanned. Our intention was to go straight from Patch #2 to Update #4, but Valve gave as the honor of a verification pass. After some iteration and improvements to meet their standards bar I am proud to announce that Railgrade is now Steamdeck verified!

Changelog wise nothing major to announce. The changes were all User Interface related to ensure text was readable but menus did not overflow. The important bit is Railgrade should now show up in your Steamdeck's verified tab.

Daniel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/ec80ce8f72568e7df5cb9535016c43cca60fbdfc.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #2 ChangeLog + Updates Annoucement
notes.content:
[h2]New Patch, Changelog, and Sandbox Timeline[/h2]
Hello Everyone!

My name is Daniel. I am the lead programmer on Railgrade. I want to introduce this patch by saying every task, fix, change, or improvement, was motivated or suggested by player feedback. Every day I wake up, check your comments, reply when possible, and make tickets. Those tickets then feed into our work over the past two weeks.

This patch is meant to improve the early game experience, address as many quality of life requests as possible, and fix the high priority crashes and glitches players reported.

What might be most exciting: we've committed to launching Map Maker with Steamworks Integration on November 21st. All to work towards making Sandbox as big as possible!

Daniel

[h2]Full Changelog for Patch #2 [v4.8.43.1][/h2]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add branch direction hotkeys on pc
[*] Make main menu song unlockable
[*] Add option to disable screen edge scrolling
[/list]
[b]Regions[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[/list]

[*] Make zeppelin pause during pause menu

[*] Remove hotkey input guide from settings screen

[/list]

notes.title: Developmet Report #4 & Patch #1 Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2]
[h1]THANK YOU FOR PLAYING![/h1]
For those who do not know me, my name is [b]Daniel [/b]and I am the lead programmer. Over the weekend we’ve been collecting feedback and ideas from across reviews, forums, and our discord. We want everyone to be able to enjoy this game. We crafted it with care, and now we want to be earnest in listening to feedback.

This weekend has been an incredible rush. So many players! And so many requests for [b]improvements[/b].

Which is good! I am thankful players care to ask for improvements. As an indie dev the worst thing would be players ignoring our game. Instead players are hungry to see more of our gameplay and even infinite gameplay! That is the highest honour a developer can ask for :)

[h1]SANDBOX MODE PRIORTY RAISED[/h1]
The elephant in the room is Sandbox Mode. Let me address that straight away: [b]we will push up our development plans for the Sandbox Mode[/b]. We will still ship the updates as promised on our roadmap, including mod support. But we will start work on Sandbox Mode concurrent to those efforts.

I do think Railgrade’s campaign is something special, and I hope to see more players get deeper in the campaign over the coming week. Still, I want to acknowledge mistakes I made in the design. Not least of which is the overly long and smooth learning curve. Even today, 4 days in, we are seeing players get to levels which in our play testing we assumed everyone would get to in a single sitting.

Which is to say: oops. Please be patient as we improve the early game experience, reduce tutorial length, and allow short cutting deeper into the campaign.

[h1]ACTION PLAN[/h1]
Now onto the concrete steps.

Our emergency goals are to fix three critical bugs. The highest priority of which was a graphical glitch causing terrain to flicker for players on certain Mac M1 Pro GPUs.

[h3]Yesterday we pushed a build which includes a workaround for the Mac M1 graphical glitches.  [/h3]

Our next two critical bugs are a crash reported on Windows 11 Pro machines if they were upgraded from Windows 10. Plus a crash on some Intel Macs.

Emergency Tasks:
Priority #1: M1 Pro Terrain Flicker [b][Status: WorkAround Mac Build is Now Live][/b]
Priority #2: Intel Mac Crash [Status: Asking friends to borrow an old Intel Mac]
Priority #3: Win11 Pro Crash [Status: Windows 11 Pro has been ordered]

After all the emergencies have been fixed we’ll work on the feedback tickets. 

[h1]FUTURE PLANNED TASKS[/h1]
Note: Tickets are in order of creation and not sorted by priority.
[list]
[*] Stop Tooltip from overlaying tutorial window

notes.title: Development Report #3 - MacOS Support is Arm'd :)
notes.content:
[h2]RAILGRADE will be playable on Macs![/h2]
Thanks to many-many Mac gamers who took the time to ask for a Mac version! To be honest you guys are a passionate bunch!

The entire game is playable, load times are fast as you'd expect of an SSD. There are a couple minor bugs I'm still working on but I am super proud to announce we [b]will[/b] ship a Mac version of RAILGRADE at launch!

With our heavy optimizations RAIGLRADE runs decent on the integrated M1 GPU. Do be careful at what resolution you render the game at though. The GPU in the M1 is not a dedicated GPU and was not designed to run games at super high resolutions. It does well for what it is, but please keep expectations grounded in what it is. 

In either case, I truly hope Mac gamers will be able to enjoy our game :)

[h2]Sneak Peek at New Missions & Engine[/h2]
Not a Mac gamer but read this annoucement anyway? Just for you here is a sneak peek. Our new "Heavy Steam" engine is nicknamed the "Kettle". You can see it alongside the weaker "Boiler" steam engine. And to the right, what is that? A large building foundation of sorts....
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/d274adfb886ce26ce00b5ce7c8ad80efae2c754a.png[/img]

[h2]Intel Vs. Arm Binaries[/h2]
RAILGRADE is a GPU heavy game. As such the CPU usage difference between a native ARM build and the Rossetta ran Intel binary should not be a difference which impacts frame rate. RAILGRADE is built, and heavily tested with profesional QA under Unreal 4.27. As such that is the version of Unreal I need to compile with on the Mac. Sadly full Arm support only landed in much later versions of Unreal. As such an Intel binary was the most tested/supported path to actually compiling RAILGRADE for the Mac.

Plus many Mac gamers are still using Intel Macs, and I don't want to leave them unsupported.

~Daniel, Lead Dev on RAILGRADE

notes.title: Development Report #1 - Roadmap & Steamdeck
notes.content:
[h2]Context[/h2]
As you may know on May 5th 2023 we announced RAILGRADE'S Steam release. At the time I did not write an announcement post here on Steam, I simply did not think to do so. Over the past month several players have joined the Discord to ask how long RAILGRADE's steam page has been up.

Thus going forward I want to post the occasional news announcement and keep everyone up to date on our progress and plans. RAILGRADE is under active development and on track to a grand release!

[h2]Catch Up[/h2]
RAILGRADE released exclusively on Epic Games Store back in September 2022, on the 28th to be exact. Since then our biggest request from players has been to release on Steam. Towards that end we are hard at work on Update #3 which will include Steamdeck support, Steam controller integration, new Steam Trains, and new levels. Combined with prior updates the version Steam players will receive is much expanded and improved since our initial release.


[h2]Development Status of Update #3[/h2]
Development on Update #3 is progressing on schedule. We've solved the crash bugs on the Steamdeck. Controller support on Steamdeck and Steam Controlller API is now solid. The game builds, and runs fine and the only known serious bug is achievements integration is still work in progress.

The new maps are still being worked on. With the high risk bugs and features getting solved our internal release date is looking safe. Expect a public announcement of our Steam release date in-not-too-long.

Speaking of achievements, I'm happy to announce for you achievement hunters out there, that we've given each achievement a properly designed icon. I know that seems minor, but we have 37 achievements and we're a bit picky on visual quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/85814ea69c254bc5b0233852a727ba976dbf638f.png[/img]

[h2]Long Term Roadmap[/h2]
Important to note our Update #3 is a true third large scale update. We have released a number of minor updates which do not count towards that numbering. We've announced our plans, along with details of past updates, in our roadmap graphic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259908/926899ee56e1ab5d643ffd6ae9485463c4af05bc.png[/img]

~Daniel, Lead Dev on RAILGRADE
